chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Abu Baseer who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the girl captured from the land of the girl who is captured from the land of Polytheism, so she becomes a Muslim. So someone was sought who could lower (cut) her, but we were not able to find a woman. So he (peace be upon him) said: 'As for the Sunnah regarding the circumcision, it is upon the men, and it is not upon the women'.
ai.seo_question: Is female circumcision obligatory in Shia Islam according to the hadith of Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this narration from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the status of female circumcision (khitan al-nisa) by distinguishing it from the male practice, indicating it is a recommended custom (sunnah) rather than an obligatory duty. The context of a captive girl seeking marriage highlights the practical application of this ruling in early Islamic society, where the absence of a female practitioner did not hinder the completion of the rite, reflecting the scholarly consensus on its non-compulsory nature.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Abu Baseer who said,

‘I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> about the girl captured from the land of the Polytheism, so she becomes a Muslim. So someone was sought who could cut her (genitals), but we were not able upon (finding) a woman. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘As for the Sunnah regarding the circumcision, it is upon the men, and it is not upon the women’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn Mahbub from ibn Ri’ab from abu Basir who has said the following:

“I once asked abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the case of a girl who is taken as captive from the pagan’s land then she becomes Muslim and she is asked for Khafd but we are not able against a woman. He (the Imam) said, ’Circumcision is for men and not for women.”’ (It a is reference to lowering or reducing female clitoris )
